newsitem.title: USA: Trico to buy 12 vessels for $69 million.
newsitem.headline: Trico to buy 12 vessels for $69 million.

text.p: Trico Marine Services Inc said Wednesday it had a definitive agreement to buy 12 supply vessels from Otto Candies Inc for $69 million cash.
The acquisition from privately held Otto will be debt-financed, Trico said in a news release.
The purchase will give Trico a total of 53 supply vessels. Its overall fleet would number 82 vessels, up from 39 at the beginning of 1996, the company said.
Trico provides marine support services to the oil and natural gas industry, primarily in the Gulf of Mexico and Brazil. Its shares were up 1-11/16 to 24 in early Nasdaq trading.
